key_principles: Glassmorphism: Use translucency to create depth and hierarchy.
Neon Accents: Electric Orange for primary actions to signal power and warning.
Fluid Motion: Everything must animate smoothly (hover, enter, exit).
No Sharp Corners: Rounded corners (xl or 2xl) but not pill-shaped for everything.
Data Density: High density for admin, spacious for marketing.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and hero text. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all body text, UI labels, and data tables. Clean and legible.

mono.usage: Use for part numbers, technical specs, and code snippets.

textures.mesh_gradient: Use subtle moving gradients in the background

general.spacing: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) for cards to allow the glass effect to breathe.

grid_system.catalog: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grid_system.bento: Use col-span-2 or row-span-2 for featured items.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME SETUP: Update `tailwind.config.js` to include the custom colors (zinc-950, orange-500) and animations.
3. GLOBAL STYLES: Update `index.css` to set the dark background `#09090b` as default and add global glass styles.
4. COMPONENT UPDATE: Refactor `Header`, `Sidebar`, and `Card` components to use the glassmorphism classes defined above.
5. ADMIN REFACTOR: Update the Admin Sidebar to reflect the new merged structure (CRM, Payments, Marketing, Settings).
6. ANIMATION: Wrap page content in `motion.div` for smooth transitions. Use `AnimatePresence` in `App.js` if possible.
7. IMAGES: Use the provided industrial images for backgrounds/hero sections. Use gradients/overlays to ensure text readability.
8. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text on glass backgrounds has sufficient contrast (use white or zinc-200).
9. FILE EXTENSIONS: Continue using .js/.jsx as per the project structure.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use generic gradients. Use subtle noise or mesh gradients.
Interactive elements MUST have hover states.
Ensure the app feels 'heavy' and 'premium' - no flimsy borders or light shadows.
